First, let's sketch the graph of $y=\operatorname{arctan}⁡(6x+5):$ 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14039967/assets/25cea33f2fc3a3bcdbc10ca03f93bd6059eb7d0a7dfcda5eb59f6f671387aea3.png)

The domain of $\operatorname{arctan}⁡(6x+5)$ is $(-\infty ,\infty ).$ Moreover, from the graph, we see that

$$
{lim}_{x\to \infty }\operatorname{arctan}⁡(6x+5)=\frac{\pi }{2}.
$$

Therefore,

$$
{lim}_{x\to \,\infty }2(\operatorname{arctan}⁡(6x+5))=2\cdot (\frac{\pi }{2})=\pi .
$$
